headline: The Iran hostage crisis begins
post_facts: The U.S. Embassy in Tehran was seized

scenes.text: [gravely] On this day, in nineteen seventy-nine... students in Tehran stormed the United States Embassy.

scenes.label: U.S. Embassy, Tehran
scenes.caption: November 1979
scenes.text: [solemnly] Dozens of Americans were taken captive inside.

scenes.label: 52 Americans held hostage
scenes.text: [solemnly] Fifty-two of them would be held for four hundred forty-four days.

scenes.label: Wiesbaden, West Germany
scenes.caption: Former hostages after their release, 1981
scenes.text: [softly] They were finally freed on January twentieth, nineteen eighty-one... minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in.

scenes.title: All 52 came home
scenes.text: [gently] All fifty-two came home, to a nation that had waited with them.
[calmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
